title: 50th Wedding Anniversary, Marks Family, Sebree, KY, 1940s Sepia Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Grandma & Grandpa Marks 50th Wedding Anniversary Sebree Ky Isiah Washington Marks Nancy (Stephens) Marks
description: A vintage sepia snapshot capturing the 50th wedding anniversary celebration of Isiah Washington Marks and Nancy (Stephens) Marks in Sebree, Kentucky. An ornate multi-tiered anniversary cake with a decorative arch topper sits on a tablecloth between tall candles. The photo exhibits significant atmospheric fading, typical of home photography from the mid-1940s era.
